english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something very bad or unpleasant, especially something of poor quality.
This is the all-purpose choice for something of poor quality or disappointing standard, including something that is inadequate.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is very bad or awful, often intensified as 好差.
Use 差 when something is very bad, especially a performance or the weather, rather than a person's general misery.
This is the all-purpose choice for describing low quality or a bad result.
Use 差 for something generally bad or terrible, such as weather or conditions, rather than physically decayed.
Use 差 when quality, ability, health, condition, appearance, or an experience is poor.
Use this for something of poor quality or work that shows little ability or effort.
Use this for something poor in quality, bad, disappointing, or generally deplorable rather than emotionally sad.
Choose this for something very poor or bad, such as a terrible performance.
